question: What are the most influential papers on organoid disease models? Return 5 with DOIs and citation counts.
final_text: {"answer":"The most influential papers on organoid disease models, based on citation counts, include research on pancreatic cancer, glioma molecular profiling, general cancer research applications, prostate cancer patient-derived cultures, and intestinal stem cell culture matrices.","citations":[{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2014.12.021","title":"Organoid Models of Human and Mouse Ductal Pancreatic Cancer","citation_count":1961},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2015.12.028","title":"Molecular Profiling Reveals Biologically Discrete Subsets and Pathways of Progression in Diffuse Glioma","citation_count":1905},{"doi":"10.1038/s41568-018-0007-6","title":"Organoids in cancer research","citation_count":1548},{"doi":"10.1016/j.cell.2014.08.016","title":"Organoid Cultures Derived from Patients with Advanced Prostate Cancer","citation_count":1402},{"doi":"10.1038/nature20168","title":"Designer matrices for intestinal stem cell and organoid culture","citation_count":1307}]}

parsed.answer: The most influential papers on organoid disease models, based on citation counts, include research on pancreatic cancer, glioma molecular profiling, general cancer research applications, prostate cancer patient-derived cultures, and intestinal stem cell culture matrices.
